purpose: Identify lawful inbound distribution candidates that do not depend on cold-email transport for UberBond's first-cash offer.

observedClaims: Contractors can create a profile, set up payments, send proposals, receive payments and find work on a free plan.
Free plan has standard discoverability and limited job opportunities.
Client-side/payment fees exist and current official Contra pages present materially different fee schedules.
contradictions: Official Contra pricing/help surfaces observed on 2026-09-07 disagree on exact client platform/contract fee amounts; do not hard-code fee economics until re-verified at activation/checkout time.

observedClaims: Accepted freelancers can create a Project Catalog project.
Project Catalog listings are searchable/browsable by clients and can be purchased directly from the listing.
Project listings are reviewed before publication.

selectionPolicy.preferredReason: These channels can create inbound buyer discovery without requiring a cold-email sender domain or a free cold-B2B email provider.
